name: Revised eIDAS Regulation establishing the European Digital Identity Wallet
description: Updates eIDAS to mandate the EU Digital Identity Wallet (EUDI Wallet) — a sovereign cross-border digital-identity wallet for citizens, residents, and businesses. Member states must offer at least one notified wallet by November 2026.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by European Union (europa.eu) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
